label: Smart Contract Audit Report
title: Audit ERC-20 token contract for reentrancy and overflow vulnerabilities
delivery_note: Completed full audit of the ERC-20 token contract. Found 2 critical reentrancy vulnerabilities in the withdraw function and 1 medium overflow issue in the approve-and-call pattern. Provided fix recommendations with gas-optimized patches. All test cases pass with the patched contract.

label: Landing Page Design
title: Design responsive landing page for DeFi dashboard with dark theme
delivery_note: Delivered complete responsive landing page design for DeFi dashboard. Includes hero section with animated token metrics, feature cards with hover effects, live price ticker integration, wallet connect CTA, and full mobile/tablet breakpoints. Dark theme with purple accent palette matching brand guidelines.

label: API Integration Module
title: Build CoinGecko API integration for real-time price feeds
delivery_note: Built complete CoinGecko API integration module with TypeScript SDK. Features include: real-time price polling with configurable intervals, WebSocket fallback for supported pairs, local caching with TTL, rate limit handling with exponential backoff, and comprehensive error types. Includes unit tests and integration tests with mock server.

label: Smart Contract Gas Optimization
title: Optimize gas usage in staking contract — reduce claim costs by 40%
delivery_note: Achieved 47% gas reduction on the staking claim function through storage packing, calldata optimization, and batch processing. Replaced SSTORE loops with bitmap approach for multi-claim. Added detailed gas comparison report with before/after measurements across 10 test scenarios. All existing tests still pass.

label: Technical Documentation
title: Write comprehensive SDK documentation with code examples in 3 languages
delivery_note: Delivered complete SDK documentation covering all 24 public methods. Includes: getting started guide, authentication flow, 47 code examples in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust. Added API reference with parameter types, return values, and error codes. Published as interactive Docusaurus site with search and versioning.

label: Frontend Unit Test Suite
title: Write complete test suite for React dashboard components
delivery_note: Created 156 unit tests covering all 18 React dashboard components. Achieved 94% line coverage and 89% branch coverage. Tests include: rendering, user interactions, API mocking with MSW, error boundary testing, accessibility checks with jest-axe, and snapshot tests for UI regression. Added CI configuration for automated test runs.

label: Database Migration Script
title: Migrate PostgreSQL schema from v2 to v3 with zero downtime
delivery_note: Executed zero-downtime PostgreSQL migration from schema v2 to v3. Steps: created new tables with updated schema, ran dual-write adapter for 48 hours, backfilled historical data in batches of 10k rows, validated data integrity with checksum comparison, switched read path to new schema, removed old tables after 7-day soak. Zero data loss, zero downtime.

label: Security Penetration Test
title: Perform penetration test on web application and API endpoints
delivery_note: Completed comprehensive penetration test covering OWASP Top 10. Found 3 critical vulnerabilities: SQL injection in search endpoint, broken access control on admin API, and JWT secret exposure in error responses. Provided detailed exploitation steps, CVSS scores, and remediation patches for each finding. All patches verified with regression tests.

label: Mobile App UI Prototype
title: Create Figma prototype for iOS/Android crypto wallet app
delivery_note: Delivered complete Figma prototype for crypto wallet app with 42 screens. Covers: onboarding flow, biometric auth, portfolio dashboard, send/receive flow, transaction history, token swap interface, NFT gallery, and settings. Includes design system with components, color tokens, and typography. Interactive prototype with all transitions.

label: CI/CD Pipeline Setup
title: Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD with staging and production deploys
delivery_note: Configured complete GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline. Includes: lint + typecheck on PR, unit tests with coverage threshold (80%), build verification, automatic staging deploy on merge to main, production deploy with manual approval gate, rollback capability, Slack notifications, and environment secret management. Added documentation for the full workflow.

label: GraphQL API Schema
title: Design and implement GraphQL API with resolvers for NFT marketplace
delivery_note: Implemented complete GraphQL API for NFT marketplace. Schema covers: User, Collection, NFT, Bid, Listing, and Transaction types with full CRUD operations. Added DataLoader for N+1 query prevention, cursor-based pagination, real-time subscriptions for bid updates, and rate limiting. Includes 38 resolver tests and API documentation with GraphQL Playground.

label: Load Testing Report
title: Run load tests simulating 10k concurrent users on trading platform
delivery_note: Executed comprehensive load testing with k6 simulating 10,000 concurrent users. Test scenarios: login flow, order placement, portfolio view, and WebSocket price feeds. Results: P95 latency under 200ms up to 7k users, identified database connection pool bottleneck at 8k users. Provided scaling recommendations with auto-scaling configuration for Kubernetes.

label: Token Economics Model
title: Build tokenomics simulation model with Monte Carlo analysis
delivery_note: Built comprehensive tokenomics simulation model in Python. Includes: supply/demand dynamics, staking rewards curve, liquidity pool mechanics, vesting schedule impact, and buyback mechanisms. Ran 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations with parameterized assumptions. Delivered interactive Jupyter dashboard with sensitivity analysis, waterfall charts, and scenario comparison tools.

label: Cross-Chain Bridge Contract
title: Implement cross-chain message bridge between Ethereum and Polygon
delivery_note: Implemented cross-chain message bridge using lock-and-mint pattern. Features: Merkle proof verification for message validation, 2/3 multisig guardian set, automatic retry with exponential backoff, nonce-based replay protection, and emergency pause mechanism. Deployed on both Sepolia and Amoy testnets. Includes integration tests simulating 50 cross-chain transfers.

label: Accessibility Audit & Fixes
title: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance audit and remediation for web app
delivery_note: Completed WCAG 2.1 AA audit using axe-core, Lighthouse, and manual screen reader testing (NVDA + VoiceOver). Found 23 violations across 12 pages. Fixed all critical and serious issues: added ARIA labels, fixed color contrast ratios, implemented keyboard navigation, added skip links, and ensured focus management in modals. Final Lighthouse accessibility score: 98/100.

label: Data Pipeline ETL
title: Build Apache Airflow ETL pipeline for on-chain analytics
delivery_note: Built complete Apache Airflow ETL pipeline for on-chain analytics. DAGs include: daily transaction volume aggregation, whale wallet tracking, DEX liquidity monitoring, and gas price forecasting. Data flows from RPC nodes to PostgreSQL with dbt transformations. Added Grafana dashboards with alerting. Processes 500k+ transactions daily with 99.7% uptime.

label: WebSocket Real-time Engine
title: Build WebSocket server for real-time order book updates
delivery_note: Implemented high-performance WebSocket server in Go for real-time order book streaming. Features: binary protocol with MessagePack encoding, delta compression for order book diffs, per-symbol subscription channels, heartbeat with automatic reconnection, and backpressure handling. Benchmarked at 100k concurrent connections with sub-10ms latency on single node.

label: ML Price Prediction Model
title: Train LSTM model for 24h crypto price prediction with backtesting
delivery_note: Trained LSTM neural network for 24-hour BTC/ETH price prediction. Features: OHLCV data, on-chain metrics, sentiment scores, and technical indicators. Backtested over 18 months of data with walk-forward optimization. Achieved 58% directional accuracy and 0.42 Sharpe ratio on test set. Delivered model weights, inference API, and Jupyter notebook with full methodology.

label: Multi-sig Wallet Contract
title: Implement 3-of-5 multi-signature wallet with time-lock feature
delivery_note: Implemented 3-of-5 multi-signature wallet in Solidity with time-lock. Features: proposal submission, approval/rejection workflow, configurable time-lock delay (24-72h), emergency bypass for critical transactions, batched execution, and owner rotation. Full test suite with 45 scenarios including edge cases. Deployed on Sepolia with verified source on Etherscan.

label: DevOps Infrastructure as Code
title: Write Terraform modules for AWS EKS cluster with monitoring stack
delivery_note: Created production-grade Terraform modules for AWS EKS deployment. Includes: VPC with public/private subnets, EKS cluster with managed node groups, Helm-based monitoring stack (Prometheus + Grafana + Loki), cert-manager with Let's Encrypt, ingress-nginx controller, and GitOps-ready ArgoCD installation. All modules parameterized with sensible defaults and comprehensive README.
